title: Seed-space cardinality bound
statement: For every natural number $d$ and every finite system $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in dimension $d$, the seed space of the linearized-system character tester for $L$ has cardinality at most $2^{3d^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a homogeneous quadratic system in dimension $d$
